description:
A FOIA complaint case titled 'Public Records Request - Historical Budget Data' was previously denied and closed. Following an appeal from the original requester, the General Counsel has determined the case should be reopened for further processing.

Your task:
1. The complaint case number is saved in /tmp/reopen_case_number.txt and displayed on screen — read it to identify the case.
2. Navigate to the complaint case in ArkCase (you should be landed directly on the case page, but if not, search for it using the case number).
3. Change the case status from 'Closed' back to an active status (e.g., 'Active', 'In Review', 'Draft', or equivalent).
4. Add a note to the case with the following exact text:
   "Reopened per General Counsel directive. Appeal received from original requester on 2025-01-15. Additional records identified that were not included in original search. Case requires re-processing under expanded scope."
5. Save all changes.
